title: Add the login page
body:
Build the login page.

## Goal

A form with two fields.

## Who should do it

**Tier B (standard feature work).**

- Claude Code: `claude --model sonnet --effort medium --permission-mode acceptEdits`
- Codex: `codex -m gpt-6.1-sol -c model_reasoning_effort="medium" -s workspace-write -a on-request`

Permission posture for every tier: Claude `--permission-mode acceptEdits`; Codex `-s workspace-write -a on-request`. Never `bypassPermissions`, never `danger-full-access`, never `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`.

## Rules

- Plain words.
